title: skills: the Studio author's page skill learns the print page (`page.print`, the printable block subset, its lint) now that #22158 has landed — #8346 ruling B′
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883, `session_01RPo7FUd6bSnAfkWMAKi848`), on #8346's ruling of record `6051470224` (letter B′): "the Studio author's skill learns the print page when ① lands". ① is #22158, landed through PR #22193. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the skill teaches after this card

- A printable document (an invoice, a delivery order, a letter, a report) is a `page` that declares `print`. There is no template type.
- The `print` keys and what each maps to on paper: paper size and orientation, millimetre margins, `repeatHeader` / `repeatFooter` over the page's own `header` / `footer` regions, page numbers, and repeated table heads and `avoidBreakInside`.
- Only `record`, `home` and `app` pages with regions may declare it.
- Inside a print page only the 13 printable blocks are allowed (`PRINTABLE_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES`). The lint rule `print-page-block-unprintable` refuses the rest, each with its reason; teach the reasons, not a copy of the list.
- List export has no `'pdf'`. A list prints through the view's `allowPrinting`.

## Also in this skill family (measured by #22158's dev)

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` teaches a per-project `/api/v1/invoice/{recordId}/pdf` endpoint. It is replaced by the print page, and, once card ③ lands, the render service.

## Surface

`skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H). This is a maintainer-approved draft PR, with the seat's 维护者速读.

Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` execution seat. The lane comes from the anchoring rule (`skills/**` → `domain:skills`). `priority:p2` and `target:v18` are inherited from #8346.
